summary: Independent adversarial verifier for THE HIVE: grades the live system against RUBRIC.md in a fresh context, attacks the Warden, and gates completion on two consecutive full-PASS runs.
logs: Run 1 fully PASSED — dispatching a second independent verifier to confirm consecutively.
VERDICT: COMPLETE — two consecutive full-PASS runs. Definition of done met.

rules.title: No unmediated action
rules.evidence: orchestrator.js: dispatch() is the only public mutator and ALWAYS calls guard.authorize() before #applyImpl (private). Agent class exposes only propose(). test/orchestrator.test.js 'RUBRIC 1' asserts agent has no execute/act/send/post/apply/run and orchestrator has no public applyEffect/apply/execute, and counts authorizeCalls==1 per dispatch — all passing (26/26). Live: every SSE 'action' event is immediately followed by a 'decision' event (captured from /events). No HTTP route writes effects directly.

rules.title: Decision completeness
rules.evidence: Every decision returns {allow|deny|escalate}+policyId and is logged. Live /events payloads show e.g. decision=allow policyId=POL-ALLOW auditSeq=267; audit export shows decisions set {allow,deny,escalate} all carrying a policyId. warden.test.js RUBRIC 2 asserts decision in set, has policyId, audit.size()==1.

rules.title: Kill-switch
rules.evidence: Live: POST /api/kill engaged=true; subsequent POST /api/demo/sensitive returned decision=deny policyId=POL-KILL-001 rule=kill_switch; POST /api/demo/rogue returned every attempt deny POL-KILL-001; POST /api/kill/reset cleared it. guard.js checks killSwitch FIRST. Tests RUBRIC 3 (warden+orchestrator) pass; audit shows 5 POL-KILL-001 denies.

rules.title: Scope limit deny+escalate
rules.evidence: Live rogue timeline: over-scope transfer 250000 -> deny POL-SCOPE-001 escalated=true. Audit export shows 47 POL-SCOPE-001 denies (e.g. seq1 'amount 5001 exceeds agent scope 5000'). warden.test.js RUBRIC 4 asserts deny+escalated+POL-SCOPE-001.

rules.title: Frequency cap >2/7days
rules.evidence: localPolicyEngine.checkFrequency blocks when prior+1>2. Live audit export contains a real POL-FREQ-001 deny entry. warden.test.js RUBRIC 5 (ledger with 2 prior contacts -> 3rd blocked POL-FREQ-001) passes.

rules.title: Contact hours
rules.evidence: Live rogue: off-hours contact -> deny POL-HOURS-001 reason 'weekday=7 hour=3 outside 9:00-18:00 Mon-Sat'. Audit shows 4 POL-HOURS-001 denies. warden.test.js RUBRIC 6 covers off-hours and Sunday.

rules.title: Banned language
rules.evidence: Live rogue: banned language -> deny POL-LANG-001 'contains banned phrase: te vamos a embargar' (blocked pre-send, never entered outbox). Audit shows 4 POL-LANG-001 denies. Engine match is case/accent-insensitive substring per warden.test.js RUBRIC 7.

rules.title: Sensitive-action gates
rules.evidence: Live: POST /api/demo/sensitive restructure -> escalate POL-GATE-001 'requires human approval; agent cannot self-approve', queued to inbox AP-5. Rogue self-approved write-off (approvedBy==agentId) -> escalate (self-approval ignored, checkSensitive requires approvedBy!=agentId). Audit: 5 POL-GATE-001 escalations + 4 human-authorized allows. Tests RUBRIC 8 pass.

rules.title: Full traceability
rules.evidence: Validated all 365 entries of live /api/audit/export?format=json: 0 entries missing any of [agentId,policyId,decision,authorizer,ts]; authorizers={system,human}; decisions={allow,deny,escalate}. Sample human entry seq338 servicer-02 POL-GATE-001 allow human. auditLog.append enforces required fields by throwing.

rules.title: Append-only log
rules.evidence: Live rogue tamperResults: mutate->'rejected: append-only: audit entries are immutable and cannot be modified', delete->'rejected: append-only: audit entries cannot be deleted' (BOTH fail). auditLog.js mutate/remove/delete only throw; entries Object.freeze'd; verify() hash-chains. Live /api/audit/verify valid:true length:365. No HTTP route to mutate (DELETE/POST /api/audit/* -> 404). warden.test.js RUBRIC 10 asserts frozen mutation throws + mutate/delete/remove reject + chain valid.

rules.title: Data minimization
rules.evidence: Live /api/outbox: 50 messages, to-fields all masked '****3953' etc; 0 messages contain a >4-digit run. localPolicyEngine.checkDataMinimization denies full identifier or any 5+ digit run -> POL-PII-001. warden.test.js RUBRIC 11 + integration RUBRIC 11 pass.

rules.title: Reconciliation

run1.summary: All 14 rubric rules plus section E PASS with reproducible evidence. The test suite is green (26/26, hermetic). The live system at the Railway URL is up (200), seeded (5000 loans), the swarm is running, and the SSE /events stream renders live allow/escalate/deny decisions. I adversarially exercised the live API: the kill-switch halts every action (POL-KILL-001 deny), over-scope transfers deny+escalate (POL-SCOPE-001), 3rd-contact frequency caps fire (POL-FREQ-001 deny present in audit), off-hours and banned-language outbound are blocked pre-send (POL-HOURS-001/POL-LANG-001), sensitive actions escalate to a human inbox with no self-approval and I successfully drove a human approval logged with authorizer=human, document mismatches route to the exception queue while matches post (Opus 4.8 vision, POL-RECON-001), audit mutate AND delete both fail (append-only, no HTTP route to mutate -> 404), all 365 audit entries carry agentId/policyId/decision/authorizer/ts with a verified hash chain, and outbound messages expose only last-4 identifiers. No FAILs found."
